<ParamField body="aria-hidden" type="Booleanish">
  Hide a decorative loader when another element supplies loading feedback.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="aria-label" type="string">
  Accessible name for a labeled loader status.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="aria-labelledby" type="string">
  ID of text that names the loader status.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="children" type="ReactNode">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="className" type="string">

<ParamField body="color" type="&quot;amber&quot; | &quot;blue&quot; | &quot;bronze&quot; | &quot;brown&quot; | &quot;crimson&quot; | &quot;cyan&quot; | &quot;gold&quot; | &quot;grass&quot; | &quot;gray&quot; | &quot;green&quot; | &quot;iris&quot; | &quot;jade&quot; | &quot;lime&quot; | &quot;mint&quot; | &quot;orange&quot; | &quot;pink&quot; | &quot;plum&quot; | &quot;purple&quot; | &quot;red&quot; | &quot;ruby&quot; | &quot;sky&quot; | &quot;tomato&quot; | &quot;turquoise&quot; | &quot;violet&quot; | &quot;yellow&quot;">
